request.text: We are a couple who love the mountains but not early alarms for a slow four day break. Please keep every day gentle, with no starts before ten and one full rest afternoon in the middle. We need a room with an elevator in the building and gentle paths only, as my knee cannot handle steep hikes. I am dairy free and my partner is vegetarian, so please favor restaurants with clear plant based options. Keep the total budget under one thousand five hundred dollars, avoid long walks between stops, and also include the gondola ride up Sulphur Mountain and an afternoon at the hot springs please.
